name: Respiration in humans
core_idea: You know that we breathe in (inhale) and breathe out (exhale) air continuously to obtain oxygen and release carbon dioxide.
supporting_evidence: How is this oxygen used in the body? Are breathing and respiration diﬀ erent? Let us fi nd out.
It is diﬃ cult to live without food for a week; without water for a day or two, but without breathing, we usually cannot survive more than a few minutes.
